visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tabbed feature panels: icon tiles or text tabs, each revealing a content panel; complex panels load from a fragment

contentPattern.structure: one row per tab: cell 1 = tab label (optional icon/picture + text), cell 2 = panel content, or a single link to a fragment (/fragments/...) when the panel contains other blocks

usage: Feature/benefit tabs on product pages. Panels that contain other blocks (cards, columns) are authored as fragments and loaded with loadFragment; simple panels render inline. Accessible tablist: role=tab/tabpanel, aria-selected, roving tabindex, Arrow/Home/End keys. Default (no option) = icon tiles above a two-column panel.
reuseGuidance: Use for 2-6 mutually exclusive panels. Pick an option for the tab look; unknown option classes are ignored.
